verdict.rationale: Sierra's marketing emphasizes agent-driven end-to-end workflow execution (journeys, integrations, payments, guardrails, testing) implying resolution rather than mere deflection, and community evidence corroborates real production use handling customer processes end-to-end for at least one customer. However, no quantitative resolution-rate metrics, benchmarks, or third-party validation of 'meaningful share resolved end-to-end' are provided — tau-bench is a research benchmark, not a customer outcome metric. Missing for 10: published resolution-rate statistics, case studies with concrete resolution percentages, independent audits distinguishing resolution from deflection.
